# Clause 6b scores mark_ignore against this root, on the premise -- written into
# `ignore_pool`'s docstring -- that the legacy tree's judgement here is "far less
# arguable than a placement". The first full dev run refuted that: of 60 sampled
# positives the agent kept 37, and what it placed includes `large language
# models` -> transformer and `Gen-neG` -> diffusion model. Recall was measuring
# agreement with a label that is wrong about a third of the time.
# So the root is audited and only `junk` rows are used as probe positives.
#   software  a library, framework or tool -- not a model architecture
#   not-ml    not a machine-learning entity at all
#   generic   a descriptive phrase, not a named entity
#   entity    WRONGLY ignored: the evidence names a model or a method
#   review    the evidence does not settle it -- needs a human
# The first three count as junk; `entity` and `review` are excluded from the
# positives, so an unreviewed row can never be scored against the agent.
# Verdicts are a proposal, read off the corpus quote on each row. Correct them in
# place; the file is the reference, not this listing.
